correctness.evidence: Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 9,331 3x3 and 7,140 3x4 margin classes reproduced both diameter histograms, all connectivity outcomes, the unique 3x3 diameter-12 fiber (size 406), all 22 3x4 diameter-8 classes and size groups, and the size-415 diameter-6 uniform 3x4 fiber.

originality.evidence: Searches under standard fiber-graph/Markov-basis terminology found the classical connectivity theorem and surveys/databases but no prior complete bounded diameter tables or extremal-path witnesses. Priority is asserted only relative to the checked sources.

value.evidence: The complete exact per-margin diameter census is a reusable benchmark for contingency-fiber graph and Markov-basis MCMC implementations and supplies exact small-model distance scales not implied by connectivity.
